shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files | sed -n '1,160p' && printf '\\n--- registry ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && printf '\\n--- tests ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts 2>/dev/null || true && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts | sed -n '1,180p' && printf '\\n--- spec ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && printf '\\n--- acceptance ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && printf '\\n--- commands ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && printf '\\n--- ajv types ---\\n' && rg \"interface Options|interface ErrorObject|instancePath\" node_modules/ajv/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '45,100p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "test tools compile static schemas once"'
